text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no shell in this environment, so I checked each fix by reading the code against the tests.

- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the policy comment and tests say five. It is now 5.
- **`fees.py`**: the late fee added the daily rate to the days late instead of multiplying. It now multiplies.
- **`factory.py`**: `sample_books()` was missing `Emma`. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned `n+1` events. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an `int`.

Please run `python3 -m unittest` to confirm everything passes.
